object: ORDER-INDEPENDENCE OF THE B2B1 CANONICAL CLOSURE FOR JOINTLY REACHABLE COMPATIBLE FORCED ASSIGNMENT SETS

setup.F: a finite compatible set of forced assignments {u_i=c_i}
setup.histories: two or more authorized forcing orders whose union of requested assignments is exactly F
setup.joint_reachability_guard: Every requested vertex is still present and dynamically forceable at the moment it is forced in every compared history; no history may request a vertex already independently solved/deleted or promoted out of the dynamic domain.

target.batch: Canon_F(P), meaning one canonical closure built from the same final compatible forced assignment set F
equivalence_coordinates: fixed assignments on S union X0
reconstruction obligations/receipts up to permutation and independent component grouping

ordered_obligations: Show final seed S_F depends only on F, not order.
Show source blocked-color masks and source-list sizes under S_F depend only on F.

Show early Z1 promotion is persistent in every nonterminal jointly reachable continuation: a source singleton can only remain singleton or become empty, and empty would make the continuation terminal/incompatible.
Show therefore final X0 promotion set depends only on F.
Show canonical residual Y0 and all exact palettes depend only on final S_F and X0_F.
Show sequential connectivity repair deletes exactly components outside the seed-connected component of G minus X0_F, modulo components already deleted earlier.
Show a component deleted earlier has no nonfixed neighbors outside itself at deletion time; hence later jointly reachable forces outside it cannot create new constraints on its stored witness.
Show reconstruction receipts commute/factorize for independently deleted components.
Conclude all downstream C0/C2/B2A/C3 objects are deterministic functions of the same final canonical state.
firewalls: No comparison of histories that are not jointly reachable.
Confluence does not bound the number of compatible forced assignment sets.
No factorization claim follows; that is a later B2B2-C/A0 obligation.
